name: Shop & Inventory
description: Purchase items and manage your inventory

commands.name: shop
commands.description: View and purchase items from the shop
commands.longDescription: Browse and buy items including protection items, bank upgrades, and training contracts.

examples.output:
🏪 Shop

🔒 Padlock - 🪙 500
🏦 Bank Expansion - 🪙 2,000
🤲 TE Contract - 🪙 50
🏃 RB Contract - 🪙 100
🎯 WR Contract - 🪙 150
🏈 QB Contract - 🪙 250
🔧 Setup Kit - 🪙 500
💧 Water Cooler - 🪙 300

🎴 Starter Pack - 🪙 500 (1 NFLmon)
🎴 Pro Pack - 🪙 1,500 (3 NFLmon)
🎴 Elite Pack - 🪙 5,000 (5 NFLmon)
🎓 Training Slot - 🪙 3,000

tips: Bank Expansion increases bank capacity by 1,000
Contracts and tools are used in Training Ground
NFLmon packs give guaranteed random players
Training Slots increase max NFLmon you can train at once

commands.name: inventory

📦 Your Inventory:
